title: 第1744章 不断震撼第1743章 希望
content_zh:
“厉害吗？那么，现在就杀过去！”
肖恩同样是非常满意这种炙热，他微微一笑，下一刹那，那道充满无尽冰冷的喝声陡然从天空之上响起。
紧接着弥漫在整个人魔战场之上的无尽杀气陡然强盛，仿佛风暴一般，在人族与魔族交战所在的地方，露出了隐藏其中的狰狞的身影。
“开阵！”
方云天低吼一声，没有半点迟疑，带动战车所有人直接就将体内雄浑的玄气，尽数的灌注入战车内。
随着体内玄气扩散，将其骤然激发，最大程度的刺激车纹，全面扩散！
顿时这玉龙战车爆出刺目的七彩光芒，上面所有车纹都在闪耀，形成了一股惊人的巨大吸力，这吸力轰轰声中扩散八方，直接就穿透了战车，蔓延到了外界。
立刻整辆就好似成为了一个庞大的漩涡，将这战车附近的玄气，都骤然吸来。
战车上，一条玄气巨龙呈螺旋状，承托着两人一兽三道身影，他们盘旋在半空，带起惊天之势，完全成为了这一方战场的主宰。
“杀！”
一字落地，战场中无数人拔刃而起，全部是魔族的人。
他们早已为玉龙战车所惊动，待得战车冲来，便是向着玉龙战车围杀而来。
轰！
一瞬间，无数的攻势呈现一种疯狂的交织，然后对着玉龙战车汇聚而来，那毁天灭地般的情景，相当的可怕。
无数人族强者面色大变，即便是虚空中的三大指挥，眼神都是变得凝重起来。
很难想象，这辆玉龙战车深入敌阵，面对着这潮水般的攻势，会是什么下场。
“鲁莽！”
那石总指挥也是不由得狠狠的骂了一句。
此时的攻势，已非先前那数百五重大藏境的魔族强者可比，而是汇聚了一片战场区域的魔族强者，甚至还有很多六重大藏境之人。
那种庞大的攻势，已经堆积到一种远远超出任何人的承受程度。

如果肖恩采用循序渐进的方式，带动人族强者，完全有可能主宰这还没有出现大藏境六重强者的边缘地带。
可如今孤军深入，一副大好之牌，就这么打烂了。
面对着这铺天盖地的攻势，就连远处赶来驰援的人族强者，也是骤然顿住了身形。
显然他们对那即将被潮水般攻势淹没的玉龙战车，都没有抱太多的希望。
“那小子和玉龙战车死定了。”
不少赶来驰援的人族强者摇了摇头，在被如此多魔族强者的攻势包围轰击之下，肖恩和玉龙战车几乎没有生还的可能了。
不过如此感叹的同时，众人也开始警惕起来，做好准备抢玉龙战车。
毕竟肖恩一旦身死，那么玉龙战车就是无主之物了，每个人都有可能得到玉龙战车。
嗡！
不过，就在此时，肖恩缓缓的抬起了手掌，眼神淡漠的盯着这铺天盖地的攻势，在其眼瞳深处，有着星辰掠过。
而指尖，也是有着若有若无的四颗古老星辰闪现。
“四星归源！”
肖恩双手结印，下一瞬，四颗古老的星辰缓缓的转动，吞吐着天地玄气，令得周围的虚空都在震颤。
轰！
瞬间整个天空震动，四面八方的攻势翻，如同一片浩瀚汪洋席卷而来，直接就冲入肖恩的四星漩涡中，波动无比剧烈，让人感到惊心动魄。
咚！
那一瞬间，只见得那四颗古老的星辰瞬间被震散开来，化为无数星光垂落，一道道凶猛攻击镇压虚空，无边的魔气汹涌澎湃的涌来。
肖恩的手掌，瞬间崩裂，鲜血溅射。
“那小子要败了！”
直至此刻，四周众人才纷纷反应过来，一个个顿时惊呼。

他们扪心自问，如果他们这么庞大的攻势洪流当中，瞬间便能将他们秒杀。
这也只能是怪肖恩太过于独行独断，不懂得战场上的团结，将自己陷入死亡危局当中。
咻！
content_en:
"Is it powerful? Then, kill him now!"
Sean was also very satisfied with this kind of heat. He smiled slightly, and the next moment, the endless cold drink suddenly sounded from the sky.
Immediately afterwards, the endless murderous aura that permeated the entire battlefield of humans and demons suddenly became stronger, like a storm, and the hideous figure hidden in the place where the humans and demons were fighting was revealed.
"Open the formation!"
Fang Yuntian roared, and without any hesitation, he led everyone in the chariot to pour all the powerful profound energy in their bodies into the chariot.
As the profound energy in the body spreads, it is suddenly stimulated, stimulating the car lines to the greatest extent and spreading them completely!
Suddenly, the Jade Dragon Chariot erupted with dazzling colorful light, and all the chariot patterns on it were shining, forming an astonishingly huge suction force. This suction force spread in all directions with a roar, directly penetrated the chariot and spread to the outside world.
Immediately, the whole vehicle seemed to become a huge whirlpool, suddenly sucking in all the profound energy near the chariot.
On the chariot, a huge mysterious dragon formed a spiral shape, supporting two people, one beast, and three figures. They hovered in the air, bringing with them a shocking momentum, completely becoming the master of this battlefield.
"Kill!"
As soon as the word fell, countless people on the battlefield stood up with their swords drawn, all of them were members of the demon clan.
They had already been alarmed by the Jade Dragon Chariot. When the chariot rushed towards them, they surrounded and killed them.
boom!
In an instant, countless offensives showed a crazy interweaving, and then converged on the Jade Dragon Chariot. The scene of destroying the heaven and earth was quite terrifying.
The expressions of countless powerful human beings changed drastically, and even the three major commanders in the void had serious eyes.
It's hard to imagine what would happen if this Jade Dragon chariot penetrated deep into the enemy's position and faced this tidal wave of offensive.
"Reckless!"
Commander Shi couldn't help but cursed harshly.
The offensive at this time was no longer comparable to the previous hundreds of powerful demons from the fifth major Tibetan realm, but a gathering of demon strongmen in a battlefield area, and even many people from the sixth major Tibetan realm.
That kind of huge offensive has accumulated to a level that is far beyond what anyone can bear.
If Sean adopts a step-by-step approach and leads the strong humans, it is entirely possible to dominate this fringe area where the sixth level strong of the Great Tibetan Realm has not yet appeared.
But now that we are alone, a pair of good cards have been destroyed.
Facing this overwhelming offensive, even the powerful human race men who rushed to help from afar suddenly stopped.
Obviously, they didn't have much hope for the Jade Dragon Chariot, which was about to be submerged by the tide of offensive.
"That boy and the Jade Dragon Chariot are dead."
Many human warriors who came to help shook their heads. Being surrounded and bombarded by so many demon warriors, Xiao Xiao and the Jade Dragon Chariot had almost no chance of survival.
However, while sighing like this, everyone also began to be vigilant and prepared to grab the Jade Dragon Chariot.
After all, once Sean dies, the Jade Dragon Chariot will be ownerless, and everyone can get the Jade Dragon Chariot.
Buzz!
However, at this moment, Sean slowly raised his palm and stared at the overwhelming offensive with indifferent eyes. In the depths of his eyes, there were stars passing by.
And on the fingertips, there are also four ancient stars flashing faintly.
"Four stars return to the source!"
Sean formed a seal with his hands, and in the next moment, four ancient stars slowly rotated, sucking in the profound energy of heaven and earth, making the surrounding void tremble.
boom!
In an instant, the entire sky shook, and attacks from all directions rolled in, like a vast ocean sweeping in, directly rushing into Sean's four-star vortex. The fluctuations were extremely violent, making people feel thrilling.
Boom!
At that moment, the four ancient stars were instantly shaken apart and turned into countless stars falling down. A series of fierce attacks suppressed the void, and boundless demonic energy surged in..
Sean's palm instantly cracked and blood splattered.
"That boy is going to lose!"
It was only at this moment that everyone around him started to react, and everyone suddenly exclaimed.
They asked themselves, if they were caught in such a huge offensive, they could be killed in an instant.
This can only be blamed on Sean being too independent and arbitrary, not understanding unity on the battlefield, and putting himself into a death crisis.
